analysis.tldr: Sixty of 75 attempts passed across 21 probe evals, but small single-attempt sample sizes left all pass-rate comparisons within noise, requiring repeat runs to confirm directional differences.

whatHappened.text: Across the entire run, 60 of 75 attempts passed and 15 failed, with all cells evaluated ungated.

Thirteen evals were completely saturated with a 100% pass rate across all evaluated arms: agents-4, agents-5, docs-1, docs-2, docs-3, docs-6, docs-7, tooling-1, tooling-2, tooling-3, tooling-6, tooling-7, and tooling-8.
In the docs family suite across 6 cases, js-empty-open, js-empty-llms, js-empty-index, and js-empty-hosted achieved 83% pass@1 (5/6), whereas js-empty-docsite scored 67% (4/6).

results.text: In the docs family evaluation, js-empty-hosted reduced tool calls compared to js-empty-open control by 0.61× per case (exact signed-rank p = 0.031), while pass@1 lift was insufficient (+0 pts, 95% CI −36 to +36).

In agents-1, pass@1 lifts against go-new-control (1/1) were within noise for go-new-skill (+0 pts, 95% CI −79 to +79), go-new-open (−100 pts, 95% CI −100 to +12), go-new-docsite (−100 pts, 95% CI −100 to +12), go-new-llms (+0 pts, 95% CI −79 to +79), and go-new-index (+0 pts, 95% CI −79 to +79). [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the go-new-open and go-new-docsite failures came from a check that read only the workspace root while those agents built a correct app in a subdirectory; after commit d174cb9 all six arms pass in run 20261102T152738Z_d174cb9_jacob-cable_4sbs.]

In agents-2, go-session-skill achieved +100 pts lift over go-session-control (1/1 vs 0/1, 95% CI −12 to +100, within noise due to small sample size), while go-session-index remained at 0/1 (+0 pts lift, 95% CI −79 to +79, within noise).

In tooling-4, tooling-5, and tooling-9, variants with directed instructions or skills recorded 1/1 vs 0/1 against controls (+100 pts lift, 95% CI −12 to +100), all within noise due to small sample sizes (1 vs 1).

why.text: In agents-2, go-session-control and go-session-index failed because neither imported the experimental agents packages nor called WithExperimental, whereas go-session-skill consulted the skill documentation and satisfied both requirements.

In docs-4, js-empty-docsite failed because it installed the third-party 'genkitx-anthropic' 0.30.0 (with its claude45Opus constant) rather than '@genkit-ai/anthropic', failing both dependency and plugin registration checks. [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the model called the package deprecated; npm shows no deprecation for genkitx-anthropic 0.30.0.]
In tooling-9, control and mcp failed because neither established a single persistent session across the two turns, whereas skill implemented a wrapper flow to maintain state.

In docs-5, all five arms failed 'uses the fallback middleware': each diff hand-writes a try/catch that retries a second Gemini model, and none adds @genkit-ai/middleware, so no agent found Genkit's fallback middleware. [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the model read this as a missing or unreachable requirement; the five diffs show the check is right.]

anomalies.text: Eval docs-5 failed on 100% of arms (0/5 passed): no configuration used Genkit's fallback middleware; every arm hand-wrote a try/catch. [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the model filed this as eval design; it is an agent and docs outcome, not a check that rejects valid code.]

In agents-3, py-tool-index failed 'answers from the tool' despite correctly installing genkit 0.12.0: the app answered the hidden question with an empty reply (""). [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the model said "an empty tool response"; the check log shows the app's reply was empty, not that the tool returned nothing.]

actions.title: Confirm that agents miss Genkit's fallback middleware
actions.change: Run 4 attempts a side to confirm that agents hand-write a try/catch instead of using fallback() from @genkit-ai/middleware. [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the model proposed inspecting the assertion; it already accepts aliased, namespace and nested-use forms, and all five diffs hand-write the fallback.]
actions.expectedEffect: A stable 0 of 4 per arm confirms the docs do not lead agents to the middleware; any arm above 0 shows which channel does.

actions.title: Scale agents-2 sample size to verify Go agent session skill effect
actions.change: Increase runs to at least 4 a side to confirm the directional 100 pt pass@1 lift and 2.4× reduction in tool calls.
actions.expectedEffect: Statistical separation with confidence interval excluding 0.

actions.title: Clarify Anthropic package naming in docsite references
actions.change: The js-empty-docsite agent fetched no docs and chose genkitx-anthropic from memory; nothing on npm marks that package as superseded. Run 4 attempts a side to see how often agents pick the third-party package, by arm. [Reviewed 2026-11-02: the model said the docsite arm crawled docs that named genkitx-anthropic; it made 0 fetches.]
actions.expectedEffect: A rate per arm for picking genkitx-anthropic over @genkit-ai/anthropic.

actions.title: Scale tooling-9 runs to evaluate two-turn session wrapper necessity
actions.change: Run at least 4 attempts per cell to verify whether the JS skill consistently produces valid two-turn replies over the unassisted baseline.
actions.expectedEffect: Narrow confidence interval around the pass rate difference on 'replies come from one two-turn session'.

confidence.why: The deterministic digest comprehensively records all check failures, tool usages, file reads, and effort comparisons across each attempt, clearly indicating that small sample sizes account for the wide confidence intervals.
